Comment: Snow Days snowball fight - where the piles of snowballs stand around the Snowhill village. Clicking one hands the player the snowball tool; the prop, its nameplate and that behaviour belong to SnowballTool, this file is placement only. Every position here was measured in game with !pos, so the Y values are real standing ground - take new ones the same way rather than eyeballing them. Heading is in radians (the !pos readout is in degrees: radians = degrees * pi / 180), same convention as Npcs.json's SpawnHeading. North of the Gifting Tree, ~35m out.
South-east of the Gifting Tree, ~54m out, on the approach to the village.
South-west of the Gifting Tree, ~65m out, at the far corner of the meadow.
